units.leftText: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
units.rightText: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

units.leftText: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you. God’s Judgment on the Ungodly (2 Peter 3:1–7|2PE 3:1-7*)
units.rightText: Mercy unto you and peace and love be multiplied.

units.leftText: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
units.rightText: Beloved, while I was giving all diligence to write unto you of our common salvation, I was constrained to write unto you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered unto the saints.

units.leftText: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed — ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: For there are certain men crept in privily, even they who were of old written of beforehand unto this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Although you are fully aware of this, I want to remind you that after Jesus had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He destroyed those who did not believe.
units.rightText: Now I desire to put you in remembrance, though ye know all things once for all, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
leftNotes: 1:5 NE, WH, BYZ, and TR the Lord

units.leftText: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling— these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
units.rightText: And angels that kept not their own principality, but left their proper habitation, he hath kept in everlasting bonds under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

units.leftText: In like manner, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.
units.rightText: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them, having in like manner with these given themselves over to fornication and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

units.leftText: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
units.rightText: Yet in like manner these also in their dreamings defile the flesh, and set at nought dominion, and rail at dignities.

units.leftText: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
units.rightText: But Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing judgment, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
leftNotes: 1:9 This account is attributed by Origen to the Testament of Moses, also called the Assumption of Moses.

units.leftText: These men, however, slander what they do not understand, and like irrational animals, they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively.
units.rightText: But these rail at whatsoever things they know not: and what they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, in these things are they destroyed.

units.leftText: Woe to them! They have traveled the path of Cain; they have rushed for profit into the error of Balaam; they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.
units.rightText: Woe unto them! for they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.

units.leftText: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves. They are clouds without water, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in autumn, twice dead after being uprooted.
units.rightText: These are they who are hidden rocks in your love-feasts when they feast with you, shepherds that without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

units.leftText: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
units.rightText: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved for ever.

units.leftText: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them: “Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
units.rightText: And to these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

units.leftText: to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
units.rightText: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have ungodly wrought, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
leftNotes: 1:15 See the First Book of Enoch (1 Enoch 1:9|1:9*).

units.leftText: These men are discontented grumblers, following after their own lusts; their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage. A Call to Persevere (Hebrews 10:19–39|HEB 10:19-39*; 2 Peter 3:1–7|2PE 3:1-7*)
units.rightText: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaketh great swelling words), showing respect of persons for the sake of advantage.

units.leftText: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
units.rightText: But ye, beloved, remember ye the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

units.leftText: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
units.rightText: that they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.

units.leftText: These are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit.
units.rightText: These are they who make separations, sensual, having not the Spirit.

units.leftText: But you, beloved, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
units.rightText: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

units.leftText: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
units.rightText: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

units.leftText: And indeed, have mercy on those who doubt;
units.rightText: And on some have mercy, who are in doubt;

units.leftText: save others by snatching them from the fire; and to still others show mercy tempered with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh. Doxology (Romans 16:25–27|ROM 16:25-27*)
units.rightText: and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

units.leftText: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy —
units.rightText: Now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, and to set you before the presence of his glory without blemish in exceeding joy,

units.leftText: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
units.rightText: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
